description: List the campuses where Fold offers a Semester Pass (prepaid weekly laundry pickup for college students). Returns four campuses — UCLA, USC, UC Berkeley, UCSF — each with their available terms (e.g. "Fall 2026"), the weekly pickup day, and pricing for both weekly and bi-weekly cadence. buy_semester_pass takes a campusId and termId from this list. Prices are in USD.
name: list_campuses
title: List campuses
